evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers ScriptPacket ID 36 from rs/n/c/aw.d; exact v308 initializes that field with concrete handler rs/n/c/ax.

Every handler branch mutates only rs/n/c/ay static overlay state: selector 0 resets j/k, selector 1 writes one clamped 0..457 progress value into j or k, and selector 2 replaces one entry in the rs/n/c/ay.l particle-style array with null or an rs/n/c/ay$a enum value.

The exact Donation Shopping Cart builder rs/n/c/aw constructs the sole rs/n/c/ay instance, stores it as its private static cj field, registers it with the live overlay manager, and binds that overlay to cart widget 60065.

No selector mutates any non-cart or non-rs/n/c/ay state. The packet protocol is therefore bounded to the Donation Shopping Cart particle overlay even though j/k are deliberately left semantically unnamed beyond packet-controlled progress values.

proposals.note: DonationShoppingCartParticleOverlayPacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 36. Exact v308 proves the handler controls only the cart-owned rs/n/c/ay particle overlay; confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exact constants GOLD_SLOW and PURPLE_EXOTIC.
DonationShoppingCartParticleOverlay stores rs/n/c/ay$a values in its three-slot style array and reads each enum's five integer parameters directly when emitting overlay particle bursts.
The enum payload includes fixed position/size-count style parameters plus packed color values; GOLD_SLOW uses gold color 16774912 while PURPLE_EXOTIC uses magenta/purple values 16711935 and 9765119.
Exact v308 usage of rs/n/c/ay$a in this subsystem is through the cart-owned rs/n/c/ay overlay and ScriptPacket 36 updates to that overlay's style slots.
